rows.basis: MD&A states consulting, advisory and professional services costs rose by $27.2M for AI data-center power programs; 27.2M ÷ 514.6M opex = 5.3%. This is only the year-over-year increase in one cost line. It excludes any base-level AI program spend and any AI share of the $89.9M compensation increase, so it is a floor.

The earnings release says record revenue of $2.02B was 'driven by significant growth from the AI data center industry' alongside C&I demand. The $2.02B is the company total, not the AI part (rule 3), and Bloom reports no end-market segment, so no amount is given. Data center, not AI.
